summary: First testing run for WeClips web (React + FastAPI proxy). Comprehensive backend pytest (17/17 passing) + Playwright UI sweep across login, sidebar nav, search→profile, watch (like/comments/report), settings (bio save+persist), notifications. All test data cleaned up against the shared production DB.

ui_bugs.issue: Comment delete button data-testid is dynamic — emitted as `comment-delete-btn-{commentId}` rather than the static `comment-delete-btn` the spec/tests expect. Functionality works (deletion confirmed via API); only the test hook is mis-named. Recommend either (a) keep static `data-testid="comment-delete-btn"` AND add a separate `data-testid="comment-delete-btn-{id}"`, or (b) update task spec to use the dynamic form. Same applies to `comment-like-btn` and `comment-item` (also dynamic).

action_items: (Optional / low priority) Add static `data-testid="comment-delete-btn"` (or `comment-item`) attribute alongside the dynamic id-suffixed versions in Comments.jsx, so deterministic UI selectors match the original spec. No functional bug — UI delete works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to ~750 lines mixing auth, video, social, payments, legal — consider splitting into routers (auth.py, videos.py, social.py, payments.py) for maintainability.
Global `_http` httpx client is lazily initialised but never has a max_keepalive_connections or HTTP/2 tuning. Fine for now; flag if traffic grows.
/api/legal/{page} forwards upstream raw HTML — but if upstream returns >=400, we still wrap as HTMLResponse with that status; works but consider also forwarding upstream Content-Type explicitly.

`update_me` PATCH proxies any fields including `current_password`/`new_password` — confirmed working end-to-end; ensure upstream validates current_password before allowing new_password (out of scope here).
